summary: Two sources name a Liles tower in Halifax County (one gives 360 ft). A 1933 article planned a Halifax tower but does not name Liles. Build, staffing and fate unknown.

notes_for_editor: Identity unresolved. The 1933 article planned a Halifax tower four miles west of Scotland Neck and does not name Liles; no source ties that planned tower to the Liles point (about 36.398 N, 77.799 W in both tnlandforms and TopoQuest). Height, builder, construction date, staffing, status and access are all unknown. Two sources agree on Liles as a tower name and location, but neither gives history. Suggest checking NC Forest Service records and Halifax County historical sources before publishing beyond this short story. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the absence of Liles was checked by text search of the article's OCR, so an OCR error could hide a mention. The 360 ft to 110 m conversion is ours; TopoQuest gives feet only. The story's 'map gazetteer' wording was not on the TopoQuest page and was replaced.
